title: The Plan pop-up lists each to-do on one calm line, open first, done folded away

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-25 15:46Z: 'but the pop up is overwhelming' (screenshot of the Frequency Space Plan pop-up)

detail: Each to-do in the Plan pop-up took three lines: the title, then a full-width assignee picker and a Notes button under it, with done and open rows mixed in the order added. Now each to-do is one line on a laptop (box, title clamped to two lines, Notes, due day, who) and two short lines on a phone. Open to-dos come first, overdue at the top marked Late in the danger colour, then by due day, undated last; done ones fold under a closed 'Done (n)'. The assignee is a 28px initials circle with the native picker laid invisibly over it, so the same select (and its pins) still does the work. Notes with no notes wait for hover on a mouse. Ordering is lib/calendar/plan-todo-order.ts (tested); styles are .plan-todo* in app/themes/frequency/admin-pages.css. Checked at 390 and 1440.

verify.note: Passes when the drawer orders its to-dos, folds the done ones apart, and renders the compact assignee circle.
